C1028.title: U.S. Court Rules: Using Another Person's Password with Their Permission Is a Federal Crime
C1028.summary: The U.S. Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals held that using someone else's password to access a system, even with that person's permission but without the website owner's authorization, constitutes a federal offense under the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA).
